title: Caring for Pets
text:
Many people have pets. A dog is a good pet. It needs food and water every day. A dog likes to go for a walk.

A cat is also a pet. Cats like to sleep in the sun. You must clean the cat's box. You should take the cat to the vet.

questions.text: What does a dog need every day?
Where do cats like to sleep?
Why is it important to take care of a pet?
options: Because pets need care to stay healthy
Because pets do not need food
Because pets live in the sky

options: They do not know any pets
